title: Stay where the heart is helped
summary: This rare human life is meant to join holy company, meditate on Naam, and make the effort to cross.
takeaway: Spend the rare chance inside Naam-bearing company.
lifeApplication: When the day begins to scatter, choose one concrete contact with sangat and one remembered line of Naam before the rare chance is spent elsewhere.

source.shortMeaning: The rare chance of this life is answered by joining Saadh Sangat, meditating on Naam, and making the effort to cross.
source.lifeApplication: Treat holy company and Naam as the work of crossing, not as optional inspiration after the day is gone.

evidence.coreClaim: The rare chance of this life is answered by joining Saadh Sangat, meditating on Naam, and making the effort to cross.
evidence.turn: Let the human chance become effort toward Naam rather than another postponed intention.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the day begins to scatter, choose one concrete contact with sangat and one remembered line of Naam before the rare chance is spent elsewhere.
